source.section: Schedule SB (PDF page 1) and its Instructions: line 17 and the Retirement Income Subtraction Worksheet lines 1-6 (SB Instructions PDF page 8; Publication 126 PDF pages 8-9 section 4.E(2)); Form 1 lines 1-12 (Form 1 PDF page 1); Form 1 Instructions PDF page 15 line 8 and lines 10a-10b (PDF pages 15-16), PDF pages 35-37 2025 Standard Deduction Table (row named in worked), PDF page 15 line 12 with the PDF pages 38-43 Tax Table and PDF page 44 Tax Computation Worksheet; tax figured from the 2025 Tax Rate Schedules, Publication 106 PDF pages 6-7

worked: Married filing jointly, you 65, spouse 61: you IRA 4,000; spouse private pension 6,000; interest 15,000; federal AGI 25,000 under 30,000. Worksheet column A: line 5 4,000, line 6 4,000; column B: the spouse is not 65, so line 6 is 0. Line 17 4,000. Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = ira distribution (you) 4,000.00 + private pension (spouse) 6,000.00 + interest 15,000.00 = 25,000.00. Federal taxable income = 25,000.00 - standard deduction 31,500.00 + 1 x 1,600.00 = 0.00 (floored at 0); the federal senior deduction is ignored. Form 1 line 1 federal AGI 25,000.00; line 2 Schedule I adjustments 0.00; line 3 25,000.00; line 4 additions 0.00; line 5 25,000.00. Schedule SB: line 17 $5,000 retirement income subtraction (federal AGI 25,000.00 is under 30,000.00): you smaller of 4,000.00 and 5,000 = 4,000.00 = 4,000.00; line 50 total 4,000.00. Form 1 line 6 4,000.00; line 7 Wisconsin income = 25,000.00 - 4,000.00 = 21,000.00. Line 8 standard deduction, 2025 Standard Deduction Table (Form 1 Instructions PDF page 35), row 21,000 to less than 21,500, column Married filing jointly: 25,110.00 (printed row, at least / less than / single / joint / separate / head of household: 21,000 / 21,500 / 13,356 / 25,110 / 10,375 / 17,137). Line 9 = 21,000.00 - 25,110.00 = 0.00 (floored at 0). Line 10a 2 x 700 = 1,400.00; line 10b 1 x 250 = 250.00; line 10c 1,650.00. Line 11 taxable income = 0.00 - 1,650.00 = 0.00 (floored at 0). Line 12 tax 0.00. Credits (lines 13-20, 30-35): none modelled; 0.00. State income tax 0.00.
